value.Name: ={{ $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.name }}
value.Phone: ={{ (() => { let p = ($('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.phone || '').trim(); if (!p) return ''; if (p.startsWith('+')) return p; if (p.startsWith('00')) return '+' + p.slice(2); if (p.startsWith('0')) return '+49' + p.slice(1); return p; })() }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, eventId: $('Create Direct Booking Event').item.json.id, htmlLink: $('Create Direct Booking Event').item.json.htmlLink, start: $('Create Direct Booking Event').item.json.start } }}

value.clientContact: ={{ $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.name + ' | ' + $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.phone + ' | ' + $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.email }}
value.clientMessage: ={{ 'Requested: ' + $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.service + ' at ' + $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.start_time + ($('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.notes ? ('. Notes: ' + $('Direct Booking Request').item.json.body.notes) : '') }}
